title: Ath-Thabat al-Akhlaqi fi Zaman al-Fitan (13-15 Years)
description: A path to assist parents in grounding their teenager’s akhlaq (moral character) amidst fitan (trials): ‘iffah (chastity) and the onset of instinct, companionship in the age of social media, ikhlas (sincerity), and building a conscience that watches over Allah.

primary_reference.info: تربية الأولاد في الإسلام لعبد الله ناصح علوان + منهج التربية النبوية للطفل لمحمد نور سويد

review_defects.english: and building a conscience that watches over Allah
review_defects.why: The Arabic means a conscience that is mindful of Allah (i.e., watches Allah, is conscious of Him). The English says 'watches over Allah', which reverses the meaning and implies the conscience is supervising Allah, a serious theological error.
